meta.source: ~/Documents/Claude/Projects/Powerpoint — Style/style-rules.md §4–5, master/README.md, Generators/house.js (theme slots, grid, type)

color.note: Brand colours are the same on every slide. The semantic roles (surface, title, ink, muted, panel, rule) switch between light content slides and dark navy slides; components read only these roles, so a dark slide gets the right values automatically. In PowerPoint each brand role is a theme slot (see usage), so Design → Variants → Colors restyles a whole deck.

tokens.name: main
tokens.usage: Navy. Theme Accent 1. Titles, primary shapes, the series that matters, dark slide backgrounds (cover, dividers). 13.5:1 on paper.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Cyan. Theme Accent 2. Second series, supporting shapes, links, section numbers on navy. Shapes and fills only on white (2.9:1, below text and thin-line contrast); fine as text on main (4.6:1).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Green. Theme Accent 3. ONLY the key point on a slide: the focus cell, step, milestone, branch or KPI edge; at most one or two uses per slide. As a fill on white; as text on main (5.9:1).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Slide background: white on content slides, navy on cover, dividers, decision and end slides.

tokens.name: title
tokens.usage: Action titles and slide headings: main on light (13.5:1), white on dark (13.5:1).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text: dark grey on light (13:1), white on dark.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Subtitles, source lines, page numbers, axis labels: grey-1 on light (7.2:1), grey-4 on dark (9.9:1).

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Boxes behind text: 'so what' panels, process detail, executive-summary rows. Ink on it is 11.4:1 light, 10.3:1 dark.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Thin rules, connectors, leader lines.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Green as TEXT on light backgrounds: highlighted labels, 'Target' headings, result labels, map and Venn callouts. The accent at 60% luminance (PowerPoint: theme Accent 3 with lumMod 60%): 5.7:1 on white, 5.0:1 on panel, 4.6:1 on secondary-tint. On dark slides it is the bright accent (5.9:1 on navy). Fills, bars and boxes keep the bright accent.

tokens.name: grey-1
tokens.usage: Theme Accent 5. Secondary text, subtitles, axis labels, source and footnote lines (7.2:1 on paper).

tokens.name: grey-2
tokens.usage: Theme Accent 4. The 'others' series, decreases in a bridge, muted shapes, the 'done' steps of a process. Not for small text (3.4:1): source lines and page numbers use grey-1 (fixed in the master v2.1).

tokens.name: grey-3
tokens.usage: Theme Accent 6. Connectors, borders, rules, inactive items. Never text.

tokens.name: grey-4
tokens.usage: Theme Light 2. Table bands, box fills, Harvey-ball empty quarters.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Theme Light 1. Slide background; text colour on main.

tokens.name: main-tint
tokens.usage: main at 20%. Takeaway box fill and highlighted table rows; ink or main text on it (8.7:1 / 9.1:1).

tokens.name: secondary-tint
tokens.usage: secondary at 20%. Highlight band behind a row, column or period.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: accent at 20%. Background of the one recommended option or column.

tokens.name: ext-light-blue
tokens.usage: Extended chart colour: charts with 4+ series only, after the core colours run out.

tokens.name: ext-dark-green
tokens.usage: Extended chart colour: charts with 4+ series only.

tokens.name: ext-lime
tokens.usage: Extended chart colour: charts with 4+ series only.

families.sans: Arial, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Liberation Sans", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif

groups.name: Slide text (sizes in px at 96 dpi; PowerPoint pt in each note)

styles.name: t-cover
styles.sample: Revenue can double by 2028 with three moves
styles.usage: 36 pt bold, paper on main. Cover title: the deck's answer in one line.

styles.name: t-divider
styles.usage: 36 pt bold. Section divider title on main.

styles.name: t-kpi
styles.usage: 66 pt bold (60–72 pt). KPI hero and KPI row numbers, in main.

styles.name: t-title
styles.sample: Margin fell 3 pts, driven mainly by freight costs
styles.usage: 24 pt bold, main. Action title: a full sentence, at most 2 lines, top-left, bottom-anchored.

styles.name: t-subtitle
styles.sample: EBIT bridge, US$ m, FY24 vs FY25
styles.usage: 14 pt, grey-1. Unit or 'what the exhibit shows' line under the title.

styles.name: t-body
styles.sample: Freight rates rose 40% while volumes held flat.
styles.usage: 14 pt (12–14 pt), ink. Body text; ≤ ~40 words per slide.

styles.name: t-body-zh
styles.usage: 14 pt Microsoft YaHei. Chinese body: full-width punctuation, half-width numbers; ≤ ~80 characters per slide.

styles.name: t-label
styles.usage: 11 pt (10–11 pt). Chart data labels, box labels, table cells.

styles.name: t-foot
styles.usage: 9 pt (8–9 pt). Source and footnotes bottom-left, page number bottom-right.

spacing.note: Slide geometry at 96 dpi: a 13.33 × 7.5 in slide is 1280 × 720 px. Inches in each note.

tokens.name: slide-w
tokens.usage: 16:9 slide width, 13.33 in.

tokens.name: slide-h
tokens.usage: Slide height, 7.5 in.

tokens.name: margin-x
tokens.usage: 0.4 in. Left and right margin on every slide (measured from the Deloitte reference).

tokens.name: title-top
tokens.usage: 0.3 in. Top of the title box.

tokens.name: title-h
tokens.usage: 0.85 in. Title box height; titles anchor to its bottom so 1- and 2-line titles share a baseline.

tokens.name: subtitle-top
tokens.usage: 1.17 in. Top of the subtitle / unit line.

tokens.name: body-top
tokens.usage: 1.65 in. Top of the body area.

tokens.name: body-h
tokens.usage: 5.21 in. Body area height (to just above the footer).

tokens.name: footer-top
tokens.usage: 7.01 in. Footer line: source left, page number right (0.28 in tall).

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: 0.2 in. Gap between columns of the 12-column grid and between boxes in a row (gaps always equal).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: 0.1 in. Inner padding of boxes and labels.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: 0.3 in. Padding of panels and takeaway boxes.

radius.note: Flat, square consulting style: no rounded boxes, no shadows, no gradients.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Every box, panel, bar and chevron.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Circles only: Harvey balls, initials avatars for missing headshots, step numbers.

stroke.note: Line weights from the measured Deloitte reference (pt → px at 96 dpi).

tokens.name: line-fine
tokens.usage: 0.75 pt. Table rules, gridlines (when used at all).

tokens.name: line-default
tokens.usage: 1 pt. Default for connectors, borders and the rule under a title.

tokens.name: line-emphasis
tokens.usage: 1.5 pt. Emphasis lines and chart series lines.
